name: cyberark_ccp_get_targets
description: Read the CyberArk refresh targets from the list cyberark_ccp_rotation_state and the CyberArk accounts to query.

outputs.description: JSON: one dict per list row: asset, asset_id, app_id, connector, safe, username, user_field, pwd_field, address, status, message; status 'failed' when the row cannot be used.
yes when at least one account is to be queried, else no.
Number of CyberArk accounts to query.
Safe of each account to query (parallel to usernames, addresses).
Username of each account to query.
Address filter of each account to query; empty when not set.
